faq.question: Is a working GoDaddy promo code listed here?
faq.answer: No. We did not verify a public code in the official pages reviewed. The VPS cards publish initial-term prices instead; this is not a claim that no other GoDaddy code exists.

faq.question: How do I get the listed VPS price?
faq.answer: Open the official VPS page and select the matching plan and first three-year term. Check the total, currency, renewal amount and extras before paying. We have not tested checkout.

faq.question: Is a refund guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. Product-specific exclusions apply. Request an eligible refund through customer service within the applicable window and before account closure. The policy also announces a change from October 15, 2026 for customers sent its September 15 notice; recheck before buying.
